item.title: Elizabeth “Betty” (Reitan) Stickel
item.description: Elizabeth “Betty” (Reitan) Stickel, 78, of Red Deer, Alberta, peacefully entered into the presence of her Lord on Tuesday, January 27, 2026, following a courageous battle with lung disease. A devoted caregiver, Betty dedicated her career to serving others as a home support aide (LPN) with the David Thompson Health Region.
